meaning: Human-labeled card sets that an LLM judge is checked against before it may decide a signal. A judge is calibrated only by `node evals/cli.mjs calibrate` on one of these, at about 90% agreement on the clear cases.

sets.labeler: the project author, blind to every model label
sets.origin: drawn at random, with a frozen seed, from cards that have at least one above-cut cell of a candidate default signal, in the pre-registered validation experiment on two new public MIT TypeScript repositories
sets.note: The cards contain source excerpts of those public repositories, so they are published with the experiment's results rather than in this repository.
